name: invideo
original_description:
Edit videos with ChatGPT by connecting it to invideo, a professional editor in your browser. Nothing to install. Upload your footage or pull it from Google Drive, describe the edit, and ChatGPT assembles the cut, grades colour, mixes sound, builds effects and motion graphics from a description or a reference, and sources or generates any media you are missing. All of it on a frame-accurate, fully editable timeline.

Review the cut, direct the next pass through chat, or fine-tune it yourself with colour, audio and 3D tools, 250+ AI models and multiplayer with live cursors. First cut to final export, you stay in control.
summary_ja: 既存映像をチャットやブラウザーのタイムラインで編集し、書き出す。
